shortDesc: Offline-first collaborative Todo application with real-time synchronization.
fullDesc:
A collaborative, real-time Todo application featuring offline-first capabilities and instant peer synchronization. The project is split into a modern web client and a companion command line client (sync-app-cli).

Core Idea:
The app leverages Cloudflare Durable Objects to store session and task logs directly in coordinate edge workers. If a client goes offline, mutations are queued locally and automatically merged upon reconnection. This guarantees strong consistency, offline-first reliability, and low-latency sync without database configurations.
highlights: State persistence via Cloudflare Durable Objects
Companion sync-app-cli interface for terminal-based task updates
Offline queueing with automatic conflict-free reconnection sync
Real-time WebSocket event bus for instant user updates

subRepoOverviews.sync-app-cli: A companion Node.js command line client interface supporting local task mutations and background synchronization via persistent WebSockets.
